race.comment: YAUSON (5) got back from a wide gate first up at Geelong over 1347m but caught the eye by rattling home for second in an encouraging return. He's still lightly raced having relished getting over a bit more ground in his maiden campaign and this trip looks ideal second up, expect he's ridden far more positively now. ANGLAND LASS (8) is a promising mare in her maiden campaign, winning on debut at Bendigo before a sound effort in quite a deep BM62 at Sale. Can improve again and sets up well on speed. PARIAH PEARL (3) can mix her form but has claims on best while CINDY FALLS (6) will be running on late and could sneak a placing.
